# ex: implicit * on pattern var cancels with outer & in substitution
# Pattern t is T (non-pointer), target p is *T, so implicitOp='*'.
# In substitution &t, the outer & cancels with the implicit *.
ex {
	import "bytes"
	var t bytes.Buffer
	t.Len() -> len((&t).Bytes())
}
-- x.go --
package p

import "bytes"

func f(p *bytes.Buffer) int {
	return p.Len()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 import "bytes"

 func f(p *bytes.Buffer) int {
-	return p.Len()
+	return len((p).Bytes())
 }
